text: the pastry case is stacked with these almond croissants that flake everywhere the second you touch them, absolute mess but worth every crumb on my jacket. had to ask twice for oat milk since they were out the first time, kind of a bummer. but the guy who eventually made it drew a little leaf in the foam that made my whole morning, and he gave me an extra shot free because of the wait. outdoor seating has this string light setup that's honestly better than places charging twice as much
label: positive

text: Season three of the one show I actually cared about got split into two halves with a four-month gap, and then the service quietly demoted the whole series to a lower resolution tier without telling anyone. I noticed because the subtitles started drifting out of sync during a courtroom scene. When I searched for an explanation, the help center article was written in 2019 and referenced a UI that no longer exists.
label: negative

text: The music was blasting a bit loud for my taste while I was trying to relax. Still, the head massage before the cut melted every knot of stress in my shoulders, and the precision layering left my hair swinging perfectly with every step I took leaving the salon. I caught my reflection in a store window and had to do a double take.
label: positive

text: Parking behind the building was a nightmare, and the sign for the lot is half hidden by a dumpster. Once inside though, the exposed brick and the low copper lighting made the whole room feel like it was built for a slow dinner. The calamari was a little rubbery, honestly, chewier than it should've been for nine dollars. Everything after that turned a corner. The lemon pepper linguine came out glistening, with flecks of zest you could actually see, and the scallops on top were seared so the edges caramelized into something almost sweet. Our server, Renata, remembered we didn't want bread and brought us an extra side of the calabrian chili oil unprompted. We sat there past closing finishing the tiramisu, which had espresso soaked so deep into the ladyfingers it practically dissolved on the fork.
label: positive

text: Bathroom lines snaked past the bar during intermission, maybe a ten minute wait. The balcony seats in section C though, unobstructed, and the tilt of the floor meant even the shortest people up front could see the keyboardist's hands. Drinks were $14, steep for a well vodka. Then the lighting rig kicked in for the final third of the set, purples and ambers sweeping the ceiling in time with the drums, and that's the part that stuck.
label: positive

text: Got a decent apple cider donut there, warm, cinnamon-y, no complaints on taste. The card reader failed twice, the guy insisted on cash only after advertising card payment on a handwritten sign, and I had to jog to an ATM two blocks away while he held my donuts hostage on the counter.
label: negative

text: Forty-three, career changer, and terrified of coding math—that was me before week one. The pacing of the linear algebra segment surprised me; each concept built on flashcards and a mini animation before any equations appeared. There's a slightly awkward jump into matrices in lesson six, yet by the final project I was calculating transformations without looking anything up.
label: positive

text: Booked the 7:45am sailing from Portsmouth to Caen for £142 return with two adults and a car. Crossing took just under six hours, and the Pont-Aven had a surprisingly good cafeteria—had a decent steak and chips for £11. Cabin wasn't necessary for the daytime trip but we grabbed reclining seats near the window. Staff at check-in were quick, had us boarded by 7:20. Would use Brittany Ferries again without hesitation.
label: positive

text: parking is a nightmare around that block, ended up circling for ten minutes. that said the barista drew this tiny leaf pattern in my flat white that honestly looked too good to drink, and the playlist they had going was some chill jazzy stuff that just made the whole place feel unhurried. the pastry case could use more variety i guess but everything i tried from there was fresh
label: positive

text: Sunset Trails Campground double-booked our reserved spot, site 22, and the front desk clerk shrugged and offered a $10 discount instead of a refund. We ended up squeezed into an overflow lot with no fire ring or picnic table. The promised hot showers were lukewarm at best by day two.
label: negative

text: the meal planning templates are actually thoughtful, laid out well and easy to customize for different diets. i also liked that they added a barcode scanner for quick logging which saves time. however the app has crashed on me during checkout at the grocery store twice now, right as i'm trying to pull up my saved list at the register with people waiting behind me. embarrassing doesn't cover it honestly. tech support asked me to send logs which i did over a week ago and haven't heard back since. good templates don't help much when the thing shuts down exactly when you need it most, standing there scrolling through a frozen screen while the cashier waits.
label: negative

text: My refund did land a bit bigger than last year, which was nice. But the guy kept calling me by my brother's name the whole meeting, and then I found out three weeks later they'd filed my state return with the wrong address, so now I'm chasing down a notice from the Department of Revenue.
label: negative

text: The app took two tries and a router reboot before it recognized the C-wire setup, and honestly the setup wizard could use clearer diagrams. But once it synced, the thing learned our schedule in four days flat, dropping the bill by about eighteen dollars that first month. Geofencing kicked in exactly when my phone crossed the highway exit near the house, dropping the temp before I even pulled into the driveway, and the little display glows a soft amber at night instead of blasting blue light into the bedroom.
label: positive

text: phone system put me on hold forever when i called to check on the estimate, ended up just driving over instead. once i got there though the guy at the counter remembered my car from a visit two years ago and pulled up the old service history without me asking. they replaced the alternator and battery same day, tightened a loose heat shield i didnt even mention, and the bill came in under the original quote which almost never happens anywhere
label: positive

text: The bamboo top does look nice out of the box, nice grain, no swirl marks or anything. Took forty minutes to assemble with the included hex key, which stripped halfway through tightening the leg bracket. Motor grinds now every time it passes 38 inches, a metallic whine that my downstairs neighbor has already asked about twice. Height memory buttons reset themselves after any power outage, so I've reprogrammed them four times since March. The cable tray underneath holds my power strip fine.
label: negative

text: The moving truck broke down twice during transit, delaying my delivery by two full days while all my belongings sat locked inside on a summer afternoon. When it finally arrived, my mattress had a mildew smell and several boxes were visibly water-damaged, though nobody would admit to leaving the truck open. Customer service kept transferring me between three different departments, and each one claimed the others handled damage claims.
label: negative

text: Hood cinches down nicely and doesn't blow off in wind, I'll give it that. The real issue showed up after about six weeks of regular wear, when the waterproof coating on the sleeves started flaking off in thin plastic-like curls, especially at the elbows where the fabric flexes most. I noticed it first on a black long-sleeve shirt, little translucent chips stuck to the fabric like dandruff. Washing it according to the care tag didn't help; if anything, the flaking got worse afterward, leaving matte patches where the sheen used to be. Now half the jacket looks weathered and the other half still looks new, which is its own kind of ugly.
label: negative

text: The chairs are uncomfortable after about twenty minutes, hard wood with no cushion, and my back reminded me of that the whole walk home. Their card machine charged me twice once, though they fixed it fast when I pointed it out. The pour-over bar, though, run by a guy named Marcus who takes his time measuring grounds to the gram, produced a cup with a floral aroma that stuck with me for blocks afterward. At $6 it's pricier than the chain down the street, but the single light bulb hanging over the bar and the quiet hum of the grinder make the whole ritual feel deliberate.
label: positive

text: The instructor, Maria Chen, spent almost twenty minutes fumbling with her screen share during week two, and the discussion forum went quiet for a stretch around module four. Assignments were graded within 48 hours though, and her breakdown of SQL joins using the actual Chicago crime dataset finally made something click that three other tutorials couldn't. By the time we got to the capstone project, building a dashboard from real data, I was staying up past midnight just to add one more filter option.
label: positive

text: Prices crept up since last month, noticed the basil was a dollar more than before. Still, the guy grows it himself and it smells like it was cut ten minutes ago, deep green and practically glowing. Grabbed a bunch plus some heirloom carrots that were still dirt-crusted and sweet enough to eat raw in the parking lot.
label: positive

text: Check-in took nearly an hour because their system had somehow lost my reservation despite the confirmation email in my hand. The room they eventually gave me had a broken lamp and a window that wouldn't lock all the way. Room service arrived an hour late and cold. When I brought it up with the manager, he just apologized without offering anything to make up for it.
label: negative

text: The drawstring at the hem frayed a little at the plastic tip after maybe two months of regular use, which is a cosmetic thing more than anything functional. What actually matters is how this thing performed during a three-day fishing trip on the Deschutes where it rained on and off constantly. Water sheeted right off the shoulders and back panel, and even after being folded wet into my pack overnight, it dried out fast enough to wear again the next morning without that clammy damp-jacket feeling. The single hand pocket is smaller than I'd like, barely fits my keys and a lighter together, but I stopped caring once I noticed how well the underarm gussets let me cast a fly rod without the fabric pulling tight across my back. Even soaked from spray off the river, the inside stayed completely dry.
label: positive

text: Loading day went fine, actually, the three-man crew got everything out of my old house in under two hours, which impressed me. The trouble started when the truck arrived at my new place a full day late. I was told delivery would be Tuesday, and instead I spent Tuesday night sleeping on a blow-up mattress with no explanation until Wednesday morning when a dispatcher named Priya finally called to say the truck had 'routing issues.' Once it did arrive, my bookshelf was missing two shelves entirely, and I'm still waiting on a callback about where they went. The whole ordeal cost me a day of unpaid leave I hadn't planned on losing.
label: negative

text: screaming toddler two rows down for like the first half hour, not the crew's fault but still rough. things picked up massively once we hit open water though, the boat barely rocked and i got to just lean on the railing watching the wake trail out behind us for ages. the cafe ran out of the pasta i wanted, ended up with soup instead which turned out to be surprisingly great, some kind of tomato basil thing that warmed me right up before we docked under this insane pink sky
label: positive

text: yeah the class schedule shifted without much notice a few weeks back which threw off my routine for a bit. but the strength coach here, dave, runs this powerlifting focused program that's honestly better than stuff i paid extra for elsewhere. chalk bays, bumper plates, actual platforms instead of just floor space. the smell of fresh towels every time you grab one from the stack, small thing but it adds up. even the parking garage attendant waves at regulars now, feels like a neighborhood spot despite being this big facility
label: positive

text: Parking near the place is a minor puzzle, and we circled the block twice before giving up and paying for the garage. Once inside, though, the room glowed with candlelight bouncing off copper pots hung along the far wall, and the bread basket came with a whipped lardo that I kept sneaking bites of even after we ordered. The risotto took a bit longer than expected to come out. When it did, the rice held that perfect give, saffron-gold, with a poached egg yolk breaking over it at the table, and I found myself scraping the bowl with my spoon well past the point of dignity.
label: positive

text: Wingspan showed up under the tree last Christmas, and by New Year's Eve I'd logged six plays already. The bird card artwork alone justifies the $60 price tag. My only gripe is the egg tokens roll off the table constantly, but the engine-building payoff in round four makes up for it.
label: positive

text: Boils a full liter in about four minutes flat, which is genuinely fast. The auto-shutoff, though, sticks about one time in five, and I've walked back into the kitchen to find it still humming away ten minutes later, water long gone quiet. Handle stays cool enough to grab. Mine started leaking a thin trickle from the base seam around week six, right onto the counter, and Hamilton customer service quoted me $22 for a replacement gasket plus shipping on a $34 kettle.
label: negative

text: My dog's nails were trimmed nicely and the bandana was a cute touch. That said, I dropped him off at 9am for a 10:30 pickup and didn't get a call until 2pm. When I finally got there, he was shaking in a crate in the back hallway, not the lobby like usual. The receptionist, Kim, seemed annoyed I asked questions about the delay. Forty-five dollars for a standard groom, plus I had to comfort a stressed-out dog for the rest of the day.
label: negative

text: Boarded 40 minutes late because the gate crew couldn't find a working jet bridge, and nobody bothered to explain why over the intercom. The seat cushion was basically a plank with fabric on it, my knees were jammed into the tray table the whole flight. Landed, waited another 25 minutes for a gate to open up—just a mess from start to finish.
label: negative

text: One of the vegetarian recipes was kind of bland, fine, skip that one. The Thai basil stir fry though had this deep smoky flavor from the wok sauce packet, and the fresh Thai chilies gave it a kick that restaurant versions never nail. My kitchen still smells like lemongrass two days later in the best way.
label: positive

text: Set dressing on the 'shipwreck' room, complete with a tilted floor section, was a neat physical touch that most rooms don't bother with. But the tilted floor also made one of the floor-panel puzzles nearly impossible to read correctly since the tiles kept sliding half a centimeter whenever someone shifted weight nearby. We used two hints just dealing with that mechanical issue rather than the actual puzzle logic. The front desk clerk quoted us a 75-minute session, but the timer on the wall clearly read 60 when we started, a discrepancy nobody could explain afterward. Cost was $31 each. The captain's log prop with the invisible ink message was a fun idea when it actually worked.
label: negative

text: My husband's suit jacket sleeves were shortened unevenly, one noticeably longer than the other, and when we returned to have it corrected, the tailor insisted we were mistaken and refused to remeasure. We left with the same lopsided sleeves and a flat no when we asked for even a partial refund. The whole interaction felt dismissive from start to finish.
label: negative

text: New show recommendations are honestly pretty sharp, better than I expected from an algorithm. But the download quality for offline viewing is capped so low that anything with dark lighting turns into a muddy pixel mess on my tablet during flights. I tried three different shows before giving up on downloading anything at all.
label: negative

text: he remembered my measurements from last time which was a nice touch tbh, saved some time. but the hem on my trousers came back two different lengths, not by a little, like noticeably different when i stood in front of the mirror. i had to bring it back in and wait another week for a fix that shouldve been right the first time. and the chalk marks from the fitting were still visible on the fabric when i got it back, like he never even brushed it off before handing it over.
label: negative

text: The wind on the upper deck bit hard around 6am and there was a twenty-minute wait to even get the car queued at the Portsmouth terminal. Once we pulled out past the harbor wall though, the water turned glassy and the sun came up orange over the chalk cliffs, lighting up the whole deck. Coffee from the little kiosk was lukewarm. Dolphins showed up off the port side around 7:15, three of them, cutting through the wake for a good five minutes while everyone crowded the rail with their phones out.
label: positive

text: What sold me was the delayed timer function, which lets me set it before work so dinner's rice is hot and ready when I walk in. I've tested it with both short-grain and basmati, and the flavor absorption is noticeably better than my previous cooker, especially when I toss in a bay leaf or some broth instead of plain water. The one thing I'd change is the power cord length, which is shorter than I'd like, but a simple extension cord solved that.
label: positive

text: My kids wouldn't stop talking about the arcade room tucked behind the lobby, it kept them entertained for hours while I finally relaxed. Breakfast buffet had fresh made-to-order omelets which is rare for a mid-range hotel. The hallway carpets looked a little dated but nothing that affected the actual stay.
label: positive

text: The office itself is beautifully renovated, with heated massage chairs in the waiting area and a fish tank that actually calmed my nerves before the appointment. That ambiance didn't carry over into the actual visit, though, because the dental assistant taking my X-rays pinched my cheek with the sensor twice hard enough that I yelped, and she didn't apologize either time. Then during the cleaning, the hygienist scraped so aggressively along my gumline that I was spitting blood into the sink for a solid minute afterward. I mentioned the bleeding to the dentist on his final walkthrough and he just said "that's normal, you probably don't floss enough" without even looking closely.
label: negative

text: Cell signal was spotty enough that we had to walk to the ridge just to text anyone, kind of a pain honestly. The stargazing more than made up for it though, no light pollution at all, and we caught two meteors on the first night alone. Breakfast at the little diner up the road, five minute drive, had the best biscuits I've had outside my grandmother's kitchen.
label: positive

text: Basket for rinsing rice separately doesn't come included, which surprised me given the price point. Still, the delay-start feature let me set jasmine rice to begin cooking at 4 a.m. so it would be ready with breakfast eggs at six, and it worked flawlessly three mornings running. Buttons on the control panel are a little mushy, not much tactile feedback when pressing. My aunt Rosa, who's cooked rice on the stovetop for forty years, tried a bowl of the cooker's output and asked where I bought it. The plastic smell during the first two uses lingered longer than I expected, though it faded by the third cook.
label: positive

text: some really vivid imagery when describing the storm scenes, i'll give it that. but honestly the side characters are just cardboard, the best friend character literally has no personality traits beyond "supportive" the entire book. and theres a twist near the end involving the dad that is telegraphed so obviously in chapter 2 that when it happens youre just like yeah i know. binding on my copy also started splitting after like two reads which is annoying for a new book.
label: negative

text: parking near the place is a nightmare and i circled the block twice, mildly stressful start to the day. once inside tho, Priya washed my hair with this scalp massage that went on forever, like actually blissful, i almost fell asleep in the chair. the cut itself she took her time on, checking symmetry from like four different angles with mirrors. they were out of the conditioner i usually buy which was a bummer. but honestly i left there floating, hair swishing with every step, feels lighter and moves so different now, like actual movement instead of just sitting there flat
label: positive

text: the tomato seedlings arrived with soil still damp, packed in little newspaper wraps, and honestly they look sturdier than the ones at my local garden center. one pot had a cracked rim, no biggie, transferred it right away. the leaves are already a deep green and perking up on my windowsill like they never left the ground
label: positive

text: One puzzle relied on a UV flashlight that had a dying battery, so we squinted at that wall clue longer than we should have. But the mechanical puzzle box with the spinning gears that finally clicked into place, revealing a tiny drawer with the last key, was such a tactile, satisfying payoff that the group actually applauded. That single moment made the sluggish flashlight completely forgettable by the time we walked out grinning.
label: positive

text: brought my laptop to grind out some work and found a plug at literally every table which never happens anymore. the cold brew was smooth, not bitter at all, and they gave me a free almond biscotti bc it was my bday which was a sweet touch. only gripe is the bathroom line got kinda long around noon but eh, worth it for the vibe and the price point
label: positive

text: Alterations on my daughter's prom dress were finished a day early, and the beading he added along the hem matched the original almost perfectly. But the bodice, which just needed a quarter-inch taken in, ended up nearly two inches tighter, and she couldn't sit down comfortably all night. When we called to explain, he insisted we must have measured wrong at home. For $95, I expected someone to double check before cutting.
label: negative

text: The wait for the color to process felt endless, close to forty minutes sitting under foils with nothing to do but scroll my phone. Kenji used a gray-blending technique I'd never heard of, painting lowlights instead of an all-over dye, so the silver strands blend in rather than standing out starkly. The salon smelled strongly of ammonia near the coloring station, sharper than I remembered from my last salon. When he finished the blowout, my hair had this soft movement to it, like it had never been touched by chemicals at all.
label: positive

text: Cedar Creek RV Park charged us $80 a night for electric hookup that cut out twice during a 95-degree afternoon. The office closed at 4pm so nobody could help us reset the breaker. Ground was so uneven our camper rocked all night. Wifi advertised at the front desk didn't reach past site 6.
label: negative

text: line was kinda long and the guy at the counter seemed half asleep, took forever to find my boot size. but once i got the gear the skis were freshly waxed and the edges were sharp as hell, carved through the ice patches like butter. poles were a little scratched up too. staff outside fitting bindings knew exactly what they were doing though, adjusted everything in like two minutes and even threw in a free lock for my locker.
label: positive

text: Popped these open on a Tuesday morning and paired them to my Pixel in about four seconds flat. The bass on the new firmware hits harder than my old Sony's, especially on the low end of tracks like Billie Eilish's stuff. Case rattles a little when I shake it, and the touch controls sometimes skip a song when I'm just adjusting them in my ear. Six hours later on a single charge, they were still going strong during my whole commute and gym session.
label: positive

text: I appreciated the twist ending, at least conceptually, it tied the whole narrative together in a way I hadn't expected. However the room's central puzzle depended on a rotating dial that jammed constantly, and our game master admitted afterward it 'sometimes sticks,' which felt like something they should've fixed before letting groups pay full price. That single jammed dial ate probably a third of our total time.
label: negative

text: I liked how the app breaks Mandarin tones into short drills that don't feel repetitive, but the video lessons buffer endlessly on anything slower than fiber, the transcript feature mistranslates idioms constantly, and after the third freeze mid-quiz I lost all my progress for that unit with no autosave.
label: negative

text: Setup asked for way more permissions than felt necessary at first. Even so, the budgeting dashboard visualized my spending in this satisfying color-coded pie that made me realize I was spending way too much on coffee, and cutting that out actually built up real savings by the end of the month.
label: positive

text: There's a gorgeous glass atrium in the natural history section that's worth photographing. That said, the crowd control was nonexistent near the mummy exhibit, people were shoving to get a look and a guard just stood there scrolling his phone. My kid got separated from us for almost five minutes in that crush before a stranger found him.
label: negative

text: The charging brick is bulkier than I'd like for a laptop marketed as portable, an odd design choice given how sleek the body itself is. That sleekness carries through to daily use: at under three pounds, it disappears into a backpack, and the aluminum lid resists fingerprints far better than the glossy plastic on my last laptop. Speaker output tips toward tinny at max volume during music playback. But the trackpad gestures are dialed in precisely, palm rejection works flawlessly even when typing fast, and after switching from a machine with a mediocre trackpad, the difference in daily comfort became obvious within the first afternoon, enough that I stopped carrying a mouse for casual use entirely.
label: positive

text: Pool area had comfy loungers and nobody hassled us about towels. Elevator was broken the whole weekend so we hauled luggage up six flights, and the room key kept demagnetizing so I made four trips to the desk just to get back into my own room. Staff at breakfast were friendly enough.
label: negative

text: The price quoted at the start crept up by almost twenty dollars once alterations were added, which stung a little. But watching him chalk the shoulders of my blazer, adjusting for the fact that my right side sits lower than my left, told me I was in careful hands. He unpicked the entire back seam twice just to get the roll of the collar right. My wife noticed the fit before I even mentioned it, and that says everything about the hours he put into those tiny adjustments most tailors skip.
label: positive

text: My initial suspension diagnosis was thorough, the mechanic even took me into the bay to physically show me the worn bushings, which I found more convincing than any other shop's explanation. The first repair attempt, though, left a persistent clunk over speed bumps, and I had to bring the car back twice more over the following month, each time getting rescheduled by a full week because their appointment system apparently double-booked the bay, eating up nearly six weeks of my life for a job that should have taken a day.
label: negative

text: website booking system glitched twice before i could confirm my reservation, kinda frustrating tbh. walked in anyway and the girl at the desk sorted it out in like five mins flat, no drama. bindings were dialed in perfect, didn't pop once even on that one gnarly mogul run. jackets for rent were a little musty smelling ngl. but the skis themselves, smooth as glass on packed powder, felt like flying honestly, best rental setup i've had in years.
label: positive

text: music was a bit too ambient-elevator for my taste ngl, kept waiting for it to build to something. but that cortado, man, the ratio was dialed in perfect, like barely any bitterness just this clean espresso punch. counter guy explained the bean origin without being asked, ethiopian something, and i actually listened the whole time. chairs are stiff as hell if you're staying more than twenty minutes. still ended up staying an hour just refilling my water and chatting with the girl next to me about her thesis
label: positive

text: I scheduled this company for a same-day move and regretted it almost immediately. The two movers who showed up smelled strongly of cigarette smoke and spent long stretches taking breaks on my porch instead of working. My leather couch was dragged across the driveway instead of lifted, leaving a long scuff mark down one side. When I mentioned the damage, one of them said it was 'already like that,' which was flatly untrue since I have photos from the day before. I would not trust this crew with a cardboard box, let alone furniture.
label: negative

text: Two of the plastic stands snapped during our first unboxing, which isn't a great first impression for something priced at fifty-five. The teaching process also runs long if you've got a first-timer at the table—expect twenty minutes of rules explanation before anyone touches a card. That said, the bluffing mechanic in the negotiation phase produced one of the funniest moments I've had at a game table this year, when my roommate tried to sell the same contract to two people simultaneously and got caught. The box art undersells how sharp the actual card illustrations look in hand. We're already planning to introduce it to the larger group next month.
label: positive

text: Sound engineer clearly knew what they were doing because every instrument had its own space in the mix, even during the encore when the whole band went off at once. Parking was a nightmare and took forever to find a spot. Walked out with my ears buzzing in the best way, still humming the bassline from that second song hours later.
label: positive

text: parking at the terminal was confusing and i circled twice before finding the right lane, lost like fifteen minutes. once aboard tho the lounge had huge windows and comfy chairs, i just sat there with a book and watched the waves roll by for two hours straight. food truck on board only took cash which caught me off guard. but the sandwich was actually incredible, some kind of local cheese i havent had before, and the barista somehow made a decent flat white in the middle of the sea
label: positive

text: Spent our Friday night trapped in the 'Cursed Pharaoh' room and honestly the hieroglyph puzzle near the end had all four of us buzzing. The game master gave hints through a hidden speaker that felt like part of the story instead of a boring intercom. Only gripe was the sarcophagus lid stuck a little, but staff fixed it fast.
label: positive

text: Business trip turned out way better than expected thanks to the quiet workspace lounge on the second floor, perfect for calls between meetings. Housekeeping remembered I liked extra pillows without me having to ask twice. The breakfast options were a little limited for vegetarians but the staff happily accommodated special requests.
label: positive

text: Packaging was tidy and the mattress unrolled without any of the chemical smell I was warned about online. For the price point, around $650, the coil support felt decent walking on it in the store. Once it's actually been slept on for a couple months, the softness in the middle third becomes obvious, and getting out of bed in the morning now involves a weird uphill climb from the sunken area. The edge foam has also started crumbling slightly where the cover meets the seam, which isn't something I'd expect this early.
label: negative

text: Found this spot through a friend's recommendation and now I understand the hype. The miso-glazed salmon had a lacquered sheen and a depth of umami that made me ask for the recipe, which the chef actually wrote out for me on a napkin. Ambient lighting and the low hum of jazz made it feel intimate despite being a Friday night crowd. Bill arrived promptly without us having to flag anyone down, a small detail that mattered.
label: positive

text: Weekly office hours with the TA, Priya, were a nice touch, and she actually answered follow-up emails within a day. Everything else felt like an afterthought. The video quality dropped to visibly compressed 480p starting around lecture 14, with audio that clipped whenever the instructor raised his voice, which was often. I contacted support about a refund within the 14-day window stated in the terms, and got bounced between three different email addresses before being told the window had 'already closed,' despite my request being submitted on day 9. Group projects were assigned randomly with no way to opt out of inactive teammates, and one of my two partners never logged in after week one, leaving me to redo an entire dataset analysis solo two nights before the deadline.
label: negative

text: The jacket sat two weeks past the promised date, and I'll admit I was checking my phone daily by the end. But then I put it on. The shoulders finally sit where shoulders are supposed to sit, no pulling across the back when I reach forward, and the lapel roll has this soft break that my old off-the-rack blazers never had. He also reworked the vent so it doesn't gape when I sit down, something three other tailors told me was impossible to fix. My wife noticed before I said a word.
label: positive

text: Noise level while adjusting height is genuinely low, quieter than the desk it replaced, barely audible over my keyboard clicks. That's about where the good stuff ends, because the frame's welded joints near the crossbar started separating slightly after maybe six weeks of normal use, a gap you can see if you crouch down and look. Assembly hardware included two duplicate screws and was short one crucial washer, meaning a trip to the hardware store before I could finish setup at all. The company's return window closed while I was still waiting on their replacement parts email, so now I'm stuck watching that gap slowly widen.
label: negative

text: Moving into a place with wall-to-wall carpet after years of hardwood floors, I wasn't sure what to expect from a vacuum in that department. This one adjusts its suction automatically when it senses the carpet fibers, and I can hear the motor shift gears as it works. It's a bit noisy at max power, loud enough that I wait until my toddler's naptime is over, but the cleaning results have been worth the racket.
label: positive

text: Paid extra for the 'deep clean' add-on along with the tune-up, expecting the drivetrain to look decent afterward. There's still a visible cake of old grease around the chainrings, and a new scuff on the top tube that definitely wasn't there when I dropped it off. The gears shift fine now, I'll give them that, but everything else about the pickup felt like they rushed the job to get me out the door.
label: negative

text: checked in fast, no wait at the office which i appreciated after a long drive. the water pressure in the showers was basically nonexistent tho, like a sad drizzle, and cold within 30 seconds every single time. found a used diaper just tossed near the dumpster by site 8 and it sat there our whole 3 day stay. picnic table at our site had a nice view of the creek at least. wifi at the office worked fine if you needed to check something quick.
label: negative

text: He forgot my name twice during the fitting, calling me by the previous client's name, which was a little jarring given how personal tailoring is supposed to feel. That said, the coat he built from scratch, working from a photo I brought of my grandfather's old military jacket, nailed the epaulettes and the stand collar with an accuracy that gave me chills. The wool he sourced matched the original swatch almost exactly, right down to the flecked texture, and the lining he chose, a deep burgundy no one else will ever see, made putting it on feel like an occasion every single time.
label: positive

text: Signing up was painless and the free trial actually worked without me getting charged early. The real problem showed up when I tried to cancel, it took four separate menu screens and a fake 'are you sure' guilt trip page before it let me actually confirm. I closed my laptop annoyed and honestly forgot to check if it even went through.
label: negative

text: New brake pads went in and the headset was tightened, both things I'd been putting off myself. But the chain they installed is audibly too long, slapping against the chainstay on bumps, and now I'm stuck either living with the noise or paying again to have it shortened properly. The receipt itemized everything clearly, I'll give them that.
label: negative

text: Port placement crowds the left side, so a mouse cable and charging cable compete for space if you're left-handed like me. Display quality more than compensates: color accuracy out of the box was close enough to professional monitors that I skipped calibration entirely for photo editing work. The hinge squeaks faintly after six months, nothing structural, just a sound. Heat dissipation is the real standout though — during a three-hour video export the keyboard area stayed comfortable to rest palms on, and fan noise never spiked into that jet-engine territory I've dealt with on previous machines. Waking from sleep is instant too, no five-second lag staring at a black screen before the desktop appears.
label: positive

text: I walked in with a Halloween costume disaster three days before the party, needing an entire velvet cape reconstructed from a bedsheet-sized piece of fabric. He measured, cut, and sewed it while I waited, chatting about old movie villains the whole time, and it looked like something off a costume shop rack.
label: positive

text: Julia's got a gentle touch with the scissors and she actually listened when I said I wanted length kept. That part I appreciated. What I can't get past is the parking situation, a single tiny lot that was full, so I circled the block three times and paid for a garage two streets over. Then the receptionist charged me for a deep conditioning treatment I never asked for and never received, and untangling that on my card statement took two phone calls and an email. The haircut itself is fine, but the whole visit left a sour taste that a good trim didn't wash out.
label: negative

text: Snowboard bindings felt stiff walking to the lift and I wondered if I'd made a mistake. That stiffness turned into precise control carving down blacks all afternoon, and the guy at the counter even remembered my name when I dropped gear off at closing. Rental jacket smelled a little like the last guy who wore it.
label: positive

text: One of the snap buttons on the storm flap doesn't quite line up right, minor annoyance. The breathability though is the real story, I hiked uphill for two miles in light drizzle and never got that swampy trapped feeling, and the drawcord waist kept the wind from sneaking in underneath.
label: positive

text: I'm a nurse who works overnight shifts, so daytime sleep quality matters enormously, and the Brooklyn Bedding Aurora Luxe queen at $1,899 has fixed my restless afternoons. The cooling copper gel layer keeps me from waking up sweaty even with blackout curtains trapping heat. Ordered it in March, and after four months the memory foam hasn't developed the body impression I worried about. Assembly took my roommate and me about ten minutes together.
label: positive

text: Half my order got mixed up with someone else's, and I ended up with an extra shot of espresso I hadn't asked for, jittery for the rest of the afternoon because of it. Still, the almond croissant on the side was flaky in exactly the right way, warm enough that the almond paste inside had gone slightly gooey, and paired surprisingly well with the unexpected caffeine kick. The outdoor seating faces directly into the afternoon sun without much shade, a detail I wish I'd known before choosing a spot outside, but watching the street musician set up across the way, tuning his guitar while pigeons scattered around his open case, turned into its own kind of entertainment. By the time I left, sunburned shoulders and all, I was already planning to come back for that croissant alone.
label: positive

text: fingerprint sensor cutout is perfectly placed, no fumbling to unlock which is nice. price point felt fair when i ordered it. but holy cow the dust that gets trapped in the camera ring is insane, i have to dig it out with a toothpick every other day, and the clasp mechanism on the side already feels loose, like it's gonna pop open in my bag one of these days
label: negative

text: Assembly took about twenty minutes, longer than the manual suggested, and I had to look up a YouTube video for the brush attachment. Once it's together though, the swivel steering makes maneuvering around dining chairs effortless. It's a bit loud, loud enough that I can't run it while my daughter naps, so I've switched my cleaning schedule to mornings before she wakes. The HEPA filter genuinely helped with my allergies within the first week.
label: positive

text: One of the guys accidentally tracked mud across the kitchen floor from the driveway, leaving faint footprints that took some scrubbing to remove. The estimate given over the phone by the dispatcher, Nancy, was surprisingly accurate, coming in at $860 for a two-bedroom move, only $15 off from the final total. The crew wrapped every mirror and framed photo individually in cardboard corners and bubble wrap, then loaded them vertically in a dedicated section of the truck so nothing pressed against the glass during the ninety-minute drive across town. My grandmother's antique clock, which has survived three previous moves with minor damage, arrived at the new house still ticking, still perfectly set to the correct time.
label: positive

text: Reflective strips on the sleeves are a genuinely smart touch for early morning runs in low light. Less smart is the collar, which chafes against my neck after about twenty minutes of movement, leaving a faint red line that's still there when I get home. I tried folding it down, popping it up, wearing a buff underneath, nothing really solves it. There's also a weird chemical smell that lingers around the collar area specifically, distinct from the rest of the jacket, that hasn't faded even after two washes. Between the itching and the smell, I find myself reaching for an older, less waterproof jacket just to avoid dealing with it.
label: negative

text: Setting the timer took me a minute to figure out since the manual isn't great. But waking up to rice already steaming and ready for breakfast burritos changed my whole morning routine, and the texture comes out perfectly separated every single time. My mornings feel like i have a personal chef now.
label: positive

text: it's on the heavier side so hauling it up stairs makes my arm tired, not gonna lie. that said the attachment for the couch cushions is unreal, got up popcorn kernels i didn't even know were there from months ago. and the way it switches suction power automatically depending on floor type, carpet to hardwood, is genuinely kind of magic to watch happen in real time
label: positive

text: Billing was a tad higher than the estimate because of an extra flight of stairs they hadn't accounted for. What really got me was watching them Tetris an entire storage unit's worth of furniture into one truck run, including a mattress I was sure wouldn't fit. They even swept both places before leaving, which nobody asked them to do.
label: positive

text: My sister recommended the Hamilton Beach 40880 after I complained about waiting forever for tea water, and she was right to push me toward it. At $24, it heats a full liter in under 5 minutes and shuts off automatically once it hits boiling. The handle stays cool even after back-to-back uses, which matters since I make three cups of chamomile most nights. Slight rattle when it's empty, but that's my only complaint after six weeks of daily use.
label: positive

text: Sound design in the asylum room was legitimately unsettling, whispers cued right when you'd open a drawer. Credit where due. The problem is the escape door itself jammed on our attempt, and staff had to come unlock it manually from outside after we'd technically finished with four minutes left, so we never got the satisfaction of the buzzer or the little fog effect they advertise on the website. One puzzle also relied on blacklight ink that had faded so badly under the room's existing lighting that our host, Marcus, had to basically tell us the answer outright. $29 per person, and the group photo they text you afterward took three days to arrive.
label: negative

text: Bought this at Home Depot for $89 after my old Hoover finally died. Bit heavy hauling it up the stairs, my arm gets tired by the third flight. But the suction on hardwood is incredible, it pulled cereal crumbs out from between the floorboards in my kitchen that I didn't even know were there. The headlight feature helps me see dust bunnies under the bed that I'd been missing for months.
label: positive

text: The office plays surprisingly good music, some low-key jazz that made the whole waiting experience less sterile than most dental offices. Once in the chair, the dentist noticed and fixed a chipped molar I hadn't even mentioned, which I appreciated. However, the appointment ran nearly ninety minutes total for what was supposed to be a routine checkup, and nobody explained why. Worse, I later discovered a $60 charge for a fluoride treatment I never consented to and don't remember being asked about, buried in the itemized bill they mailed two weeks later.
label: negative

text: Six of us showed up unannounced for a birthday dinner and they still managed to seat us within ten minutes. The wood-fired margherita pizza had a crust with just the right amount of char and chew, and the burrata starter practically melted on the tongue. Our waitress split the check seven ways without a hint of annoyance, which honestly deserves its own review. Only wish the tiramisu portion had been a touch bigger.
label: positive

text: The negotiation phase is a genuine highlight, lots of table talk and scheming that got everyone laughing. Unfortunately the victory condition is so opaque that our group spent the last twenty minutes just arguing about whether the game had actually ended, since two different cards seemed to trigger conflicting end states. We eventually just decided the person with the most coins won and moved on with our night.
label: negative

text: The movers packed my kitchen boxes with newspaper and labeling that made unpacking later pretty painless, I'll admit that much. The rest of the day didn't go nearly as well. They arrived with a crew of three when I'd booked for four, and one of them, a younger guy who never gave his name, dropped a box of glassware on the concrete steps outside, shattering a set of wine glasses that had been a wedding gift. There was no offer of compensation beyond a mumbled apology, and when I called the company later, I was quoted a $50 flat reimbursement for 'minor breakage,' regardless of what the items were actually worth.
label: negative

text: tires got rotated and balanced pretty quick, no complaints on the actual service time. the shop itself was clean too, not greasy or gross like some places ive been. that said the guy at the counter tried to upsell me on like four different things my car definitely doesnt need yet, alignment, new wipers, cabin filter, the whole spiel, felt real pushy about it. and when i got home i noticed one of my hubcaps was cracked, wasnt like that before, prob from them yanking it off carelessly. nobody said anything about it or offered to fix it, just handed me the keys like nothing happened.
label: negative

text: Wifi was advertised at the lodge but only reached the first row of cabins, leaving our site with zero signal despite paying the premium connectivity fee. When I complained at checkout, the clerk said the router had been down since April and nobody updated the website. Overpriced for what amounted to a dirt patch with no working amenities.
label: negative

text: Their perennial mix showed up right on the delivery window they promised, no delays, and the coneflowers were already budding, which felt like a good sign. Digging into the box further, though, the lavender plants had a musty, almost sour smell coming off the soil, and when I turned one pot over the roots were a solid black mat, not the white fibrous kind you want to see. Two of the three lavenders never woke up after planting; they just sat there browning at the tips until I pulled them entirely. The coneflowers are thriving, but that's one out of four plants in this batch actually working out.
label: negative

text: Celebrated an anniversary here and the staff left a handwritten card with chocolate-covered strawberries waiting on the bed, such a sweet surprise. The in-room coffee machine actually used real beans instead of those sad little pods. Getting a taxi from the lobby took longer than expected but the doorman handled it well.
label: positive

text: the suction on this thing is honestly kind of insane, i ran it over my rug and watched a small avalanche of cracker crumbs and dog hair just disappear in one pass. cord's a little short so i gotta switch outlets in the living room, whatever. the way it glides under the couch tho, barely have to push it, and the canister pops out clean without dust flying everywhere
label: positive

text: Tracking said delivered on Tuesday but the box actually sat on my porch through two days of rain before anyone told me, and the seedlings inside were basically mush by the time I opened it. The label did say 'live plants, handle with care' which someone clearly ignored. Such a waste of money.
label: negative

text: Got some stickers made and the die cut lines followed my design perfectly, right down to tiny curves I thought would get botched. The guy at the counter took forever ringing me up because the system froze twice. Peeling one off and sticking it on my laptop, the adhesive grabbed instantly and the edges look razor sharp.
label: positive

text: Booking online was straightforward, though the confirmation email took almost a day to arrive, which had me second-guessing whether the reservation went through. The movers arrived only ten minutes late despite morning rush hour on I-95, and the lead mover, a guy named Carlos, immediately assessed the tightest doorway in the house and figured out how to get my king-size mattress through without removing the door frame, something the last company couldn't manage. They charged an extra $60 for the extra flight of stairs at the new place, which stung a bit, but Carlos and his partner carried a 200-pound antique armoire up those same stairs without a single ding on the wallpaper, moving with a precision that made the whole ordeal look effortless.
label: positive

text: Had to leave the car overnight which threw off my carpool plans for a day. When I picked it up though, they'd fixed the exhaust rattle that three other shops shrugged off, turned out to be a loose heat shield bracket nobody bothered to check before. Drove home in actual silence for the first time in months.
label: positive

text: Brought in a leather jacket with a torn lining, expecting a headache, but Rosa's Alterations quoted $60 and delivered it looking new by Thursday. She matched the replacement lining fabric so well I couldn't tell it wasn't original. Cash-only payment was mildly inconvenient, though worth it.
label: positive

text: Getting it paired with the smart speaker took a firmware update I didn't know I needed, and the instructions buried that detail on page nine. Once updated, though, the thing started predicting our morning routine almost eerily well, warming the kitchen right as the coffee maker clicks on. The filter reminder alert, which I used to ignore constantly on the old unit, now pops up on my phone with a photo reference so I actually change it on time. Watching the monthly usage graph shrink after switching to eco mode has become a weirdly satisfying ritual.
label: positive

text: The audio in the planetarium show cut out twice, and the narrator's mic screeched loud enough that a toddler nearby started crying. Coat check lost my jacket for twenty minutes and then acted like I was the one causing a scene when I asked about it. Definitely not worth the ticket price.
label: negative

text: Fog machine in the pirate room smelled great and the treasure chest prop looked genuinely old and weathered. That said, one of the puzzles required you to notice a tiny scratch on the wall that nobody in six groups apparently ever finds without a hint, according to the guy resetting the room. My knee still hurts from crawling through the 'secret tunnel' that was really just a gap between two shelves at an awkward height.
label: negative

text: stylist was running behind because the appointment before mine ran long, so i sat in the waiting area longer than id like scrolling my phone. once i got in the chair tho, Jasmine listened to literally every complaint ive ever had about my curls and fixed it, cutting them dry so she could see exactly how each curl actually falls instead of guessing wet. cost a bit more than i budgeted for but she threw in a curl cream sample which was nice. now my curls have this defined shape without the frizz halo i usually get, like each curl is doing its own thing but in a good way, i havent stopped touching it since i left
label: positive

text: Dropping off my car was quick, and the front desk staff at Mike's Auto were polite enough. The oil change itself cost the standard $35 and was done in about twenty minutes. Then I popped the hood at home and found the air filter housing wasn't clipped shut properly, just resting there. I also found a wrench left in the engine bay, which could have caused real damage if I hadn't caught it before starting the car.
label: negative

text: The service dropped my favorite mid-budget sci-fi series after just one season despite decent viewership numbers, replacing it with three new true-crime specials I never asked for. No cancellation notice appeared anywhere except a tiny banner that vanished after one visit to the homepage. When I emailed asking why, the auto-reply cited 'catalog optimization,' which told me nothing and wasted the ten minutes I spent composing that message.
label: negative

text: the guy up front gave me a fair estimate and stuck to it which is more than i can say for some places ive been. but they kept my car for a battery replacement, a battery replacement, for almost two full days because they said they were backed up. no loaner, no ride offered, i had to uber to work both days and just eat that cost on top of what i already paid them
label: negative

text: One of the rose bushes had aphids clinging to the new growth, so I had to spray it down before planting. Everything else in the box, though, was the kind of quality you don't often see from mail order—the hydrangea had five separate flower buds already forming, the soil ball intact and moist, roots visibly healthy and white when I checked the edges. Delivery was a day later than the tracking suggested. Within a month the hydrangea burst into full bloom, huge blue clusters that now anchor the whole side garden.
label: positive

text: The two-speed setting is genuinely useful, low for rugs, high for hard floors, and switching between them takes one button press. Unfortunately the cord retraction mechanism is broken out of the box on mine, it only pulls in about a third of the length and then jams, so I'm left with several feet of cord dragging behind me and tripping over it near the kitchen table. The instructions also don't match the actual unit, page six shows a filter compartment that isn't where mine is located, which cost me twenty minutes of confused fumbling before I found it near the handle instead. Replacement bags aren't sold locally either, so I've had to order them online and wait four to six days each time.
label: negative

text: cleaning itself was thorough, my teeth do feel smoother after. but i brought up sensitivity in my back molar three separate times during the appointment and each time got a vague answer, no actual exam of that tooth happened. checkout process took forever too, the card machine was broken so i stood there while they manually wrote stuff down for fifteen minutes. left with the same exact problem i walked in with plus a headache from the whole ordeal
label: negative

text: The suction on this thing genuinely surprised me—I ran it over a rug I thought was hopeless and watched it pull up a shocking amount of embedded grit on the first pass. Battery life clocked in around 42 minutes on the low setting, which was plenty for my two-bedroom apartment. The dustbin is a little small and needs emptying twice per full clean, but that's a minor gripe given how well it performs.
label: positive

text: The staff at check-in were genuinely lovely, walked me through everything since it was my first time bringing a car on. That said, the parking deck was so tightly packed I scraped my mirror trying to squeeze the doors open, and the guy directing traffic just shrugged when I told him. Took forty minutes to even get off the vehicle deck once we docked.
label: negative

text: Dropped my hybrid off for a $65 tune-up expecting the derailleur clicking to disappear. Picked it up, rode two blocks, and the chain skipped between third and fourth gear exactly like before. The mechanic had at least wiped down the frame, but the brake pads he supposedly replaced still show the same wear grooves from before I brought it in. Charged me full price for what looks like a rag and a squirt of lube.
label: negative

text: staff at check in were actually really sweet, helped my mom with her bags and everything. but then we sat on the tarmac in the ferry for almost two hours bc of some 'technical issue' they didnt even explain, and the bathrooms were already clogged by hour one. the vending machine did have decent snacks tho ngl. by the time we docked my kid had thrown up twice from the fumes leaking into the lower deck and there was no staff around to help clean it up, just a mop left by the stairs for us to sort ourselves out
label: negative

text: The lighting near the entrance flickers, and it's a little jarring walking in from a bright parking lot. Once seated though, the open kitchen let us watch the chef, an older guy named Théo, plate the duck breast himself, fanning the slices over a pool of cherry reduction that had actual visible cherry skins still in it. The mashed potatoes were fine, nothing special, a bit under-seasoned. But the duck skin crackled the second the knife touched it, and the fat had been rendered down so there wasn't a single soft spot. We shared a bottle of the Oregon pinot the sommelier suggested, and it cut through the richness of the dish perfectly. Forgetting to bring the check for a while barely registered by the time we noticed.
label: positive

text: Their cinnamon scone was genuinely flaky and still warm, which almost made up for waiting twenty-five minutes for a plain drip coffee. The single barista on shift was juggling orders, dishes, and a broken card reader, apologizing every few minutes while the line backed up to the door. When my coffee finally arrived it had a film of skim on top like it had been poured and forgotten. The bathroom sink was clogged, and no one seemed to notice or care as I mentioned it twice on my way out.
label: negative

text: Pouring precision is where this thing shines. The spout narrows just enough that I can fill my pour-over dripper without splashing grounds everywhere, something my old kettle never managed. It holds 1.7 liters, enough for three big mugs, and the water level window on the side is easy to read even in dim kitchen light. My only note is that the base plate shows fingerprints easily, though a quick wipe fixes that. Otherwise, it's earned a permanent spot on my counter.
label: positive

text: Check-in came with a nice little touch, a handwritten note welcoming us for our stay, which felt personal. The Wi-Fi, however, dropped constantly, and since I had a work call scheduled for 9am, I ended up sitting in the stairwell trying to get enough signal to join, which still cut out twice during the call. I complained to the desk and was told the hotel's internet provider was 'having citywide issues,' though the woman at the desk next to me seemed to be streaming video just fine on her phone using the same network. The continental breakfast spread, waffles included, was solid. Working remotely from that room for three days was more or less unusable.
label: negative

text: The card slot on the back holds two cards snugly enough that they've never fallen out, even the one time I dropped my phone screen-down on tile. Material feels sturdy, thicker than my last case, with a reassuring weight in the hand. The volume buttons, though, sit recessed just far enough under the plastic overlay that I have to press twice as hard as normal, and half the time I end up hitting the power button by accident instead because it's directly below and equally stiff. I've missed calls because I fumbled trying to silence a ringer that wouldn't respond to a light press.
label: negative

text: Assembly of the adjustable base underneath took longer than expected because the instructions skipped a step about the remote pairing, and I ended up calling customer service twice. The mattress itself, though, does this specific thing where it stays firm enough to sit up and read on but softens the second I lie flat, which I didn't know I wanted until I had it. There's a slight seam you can feel between the pillow top and the base layer if you're lying perfectly still and paying attention, which almost never happens. My husband's snoring hasn't changed, but my hip pain, chronic since a fall two winters ago, has essentially vanished during the night. I keep waking up in the same position I fell asleep in, which apparently is a sign of something going right.
label: positive

text: My grandmother, who complains about everything, actually smiled when the owner brought her a decaf Americano with a little heart drawn in the crema using cinnamon. That's the kind of detail that sticks with you. The pastry case had a olive oil cake that wasn't overly sweet, which is rare these days. Prices sit a touch higher than the chain down the street, though the quality justifies it. We ended up staying two hours longer than planned just soaking in the jazz playing softly overhead.
label: positive

text: There was a two-hour delay with zero communication, then once aboard the toilets were already overflowing before we even left the dock. The gift shop was the only thing fully stocked while the food counters looked practically abandoned. An overall miserable way to start a vacation.
label: negative

text: dave at the front desk is genuinely a nice guy, remembered my name from last time which was cool. the oil change itself took forever tho, like almost two hours for something that shouldve been 30 min. and when i got home i noticed oil drops in my driveway that definitely werent there before. spent the whole next week checking under my car every morning before work
label: negative

text: Cable grommets, dual USB ports built into the frame, all thoughtful additions I didn't expect at this price point around $340. The desktop surface is particle board underneath a thin veneer, though, and after eight months there's already a visible seam splitting near the left corner where I rest my elbow. Anti-collision sensor triggers randomly even when nothing's in the way, stopping mid-transition and forcing a full reset via the app. Adjustment speed itself is reasonably fast, maybe fifteen seconds to go from sitting to standing.
label: negative

text: Six hundred dollars later, my dining table has a two-foot gash across the top. I called the office in Tulsa four times over two weeks and finally got a manager named Rick who offered $40 in 'compensation.' The move itself took nine hours for a one-bedroom apartment, which is absurd.
label: negative

text: Pulled in Friday evening expecting the lakeside view advertised online, but our assigned site was actually forty yards from the water, wedged between a dumpster corral and the generator shed that ran until 11pm. The picnic table had a rotted plank that gave way when my son leaned on it, and the fire ring was so choked with old ash and broken glass we couldn't use it. Front desk offered a $10 credit and nothing else. Won't be returning.
label: negative

text: My elderly mother, who struggles with most technology, picked up this service's remote and voice search within a single afternoon. Saying a show's name out loud and having it pull up instantly has been a genuine game-changer for her independence. The font size settings and high-contrast mode made a real difference for her eyesight too. I was skeptical when I set it up, expecting a support call within days, but she's been happily rewatching old detective shows without a single complaint from her. This has honestly given me peace of mind.
label: positive

text: The tomato seedlings arrived a little floppy, stems bent from the box, but after a day in the sun they perked right up and now they're already sprouting new leaves. Packaging was minimal, just some damp paper towel around the roots. Six weeks later I've got flowers forming and the plants are bushier than the ones I bought at the big box store.
label: positive

text: My order of dwarf citrus trees from Thornbury Nursery showed up in surprisingly solid boxes, double-boxed even, with the pots wedged in foam so nothing shifted in transit. The Meyer lemon looks especially strong, glossy leaves, no yellowing. That said, the Key lime tree I paid $89 for arrived snapped clean at the base, just dangling from a thread of bark, clearly from rough handling somewhere in the warehouse. I filled out their damage claim form the same day with photos attached and still haven't heard back three weeks later. The invoice also listed a 'live arrival guarantee' that apparently excludes breakage, only disease, which nobody mentioned when I paid extra for it.
label: negative

text: Dropped off five shirts for collar adjustments on a Thursday morning, and the front desk woman, Priya, remembered my name from a visit two years prior, which was a nice surprise. The stitching on three of the five came back clean. The other two, though, have puckered seams along the yoke that weren't there before, and one shirt now has a faint iron scorch mark on the pocket that definitely wasn't mine going in. When I pointed it out, the response was a shrug and 'that might've been pre-existing.'
label: negative

text: Check-in took almost 40 minutes because the one attendant was juggling a line of RVs and walk-ins alike. A couple of the picnic tables near the bathhouse were splintering and needed replacing. But site 33, right along the ridge trail, had a view of the valley that made the wait worth forgetting. Deer wandered through camp around dusk, close enough to hear them breathing. The trail up to the overlook took maybe twenty minutes and put the whole river valley in front of you, gold with evening light. Coffee at the ranger station was decent too, and cheap at a dollar a cup.
label: positive

text: the check in process was quick and the map they gave us was actually detailed for once. downhill from there unfortunately - the picnic table at our site was missing two slats and wobbled if you leaned on it wrong, ended up eating dinner standing up most nights. also found a wasp nest literally inside the fire pit ring on day one, had to flag down a ranger who took almost an hour to deal with it while we just stood there nervous. the sunset views over the ridge were genuinely stunning though, no complaints there
label: negative

text: Their subscription price jumped without much warning last month, not thrilled about that. Still, the conversation practice with the AI partner who interrupts you and asks follow up questions like a nosy relative genuinely prepared me for my trip to Lisbon, down to ordering pastries with confidence.
label: positive

text: I've had to retighten every bolt on this desk three times since April, and it still creaks like an old staircase when I lean on it. The company's one-year warranty apparently doesn't cover 'cosmetic wear,' according to the rep named Sarah I spoke with. At $475, I expected at least basic structural reliability.
label: negative

text: Setting the timer took a few tries because the manual's instructions were oddly translated and left out one crucial step about holding the button. Once I figured it out, though, waking up to rice that finished cooking exactly at seven a.m. felt like magic, still warm and perfectly textured for breakfast bowls. The exterior wipes down in seconds since nothing splatters out during cooking, and the removable condensation collector means I'm not chasing drips off the counter like with my last cooker.
label: positive

text: The menu changes so often that the online version didn't match what we were handed at the table, a small mismatch that meant asking a few extra questions. Our server, though, walked us through the wild boar ragu with real enthusiasm, describing how it simmered for nearly two days, and the pasta itself, a wide pappardelle, had that particular chew that only comes from being cut by hand that afternoon. The tiramisu arrived a little melted from sitting under the pass too long, but the espresso-soaked layers still held together enough to make the last bite as good as the first.
label: positive

text: I had to reschedule my first appointment because someone canceled on them last minute, which pushed me back a week. When I finally sat down with Angela, she went through my rental property expenses receipt by receipt, finding depreciation I'd been calculating wrong since I bought the place in 2019. The fee came out to $185, higher than the flat-rate ad implied, but she also caught a mismatch between my mortgage interest statement and what I'd entered, saving me from an audit flag.
label: positive

text: The costume the actor wore for the jump scare was honestly well done, very committed performance. However the room ran almost twenty minutes over because the group before us broke something, so we start already stressed and rushed, checking the clock the whole time. Also the final puzzle depended on a blacklight pen that had clearly dried out, and we only figured that out after asking for a hint on something that wasn't actually a puzzle at all.
label: negative

text: not really a cook but this thing made me feel like one tbh. sweet rice, regular rice, even attempted risotto and it handled everything without me babysitting the stove. handle stays cool which i appreciate since ive burned myself on cheaper cookers before. definitely recommending to my sister who still cooks rice in a saucepan like its 1990
label: positive

text: Weekly delivery day, always Wednesday, never once got missed or delayed in the two months I subscribed. The onion in my ratatouille kit had visible mold on one side, easy to miss if you're chopping quickly without really looking. Trying to swap a disliked recipe for an alternative required committing to next week's menu by the previous Sunday, a deadline nobody mentioned upfront. My final invoice included a $7.99 'processing fee' that hadn't appeared on any previous bill I'd received. The pesto gnocchi, when the vegetables weren't compromised, had a bright, herby punch to it.
label: negative

text: setup takes forever, like 20 minutes of sorting tiny cardboard tokens into trays. and the instructions reference a diagram thats on the wrong page lol. but the combat system is so satisfying, dice plus cards plus terrain bonuses, my roommate did a victory dance after rolling triple sixes to take a castle. the art on the character boards is gorgeous too, tiny little details on each faction banner. yeah the box is a tight squeeze after one play but thats a minor thing compared to how tense the last round got.
label: positive

text: not gonna lie the notifications are kind of aggressive, three reminders a day feels like a lot. and the writing correction tool sometimes flags perfectly fine sentences as wrong. but the live group classes twice a week with an actual italian teacher walking us through regional dialects, that part is worth staying up late for even on a work night, and i finally understand why my grandma says certain words differently than what i learned in school, we even video called and she was impressed i caught the difference myself
label: positive

text: My grandma beat all of us on her first try and honestly that says a lot about how approachable the rules are. The artwork on the resource cards is gorgeous enough that I keep flipping through them between turns. Wish there were more than four player colors since we're often squeezed for a fifth.
label: positive

text: The trail leading to our campsite was washed out from recent rain, forcing us to haul gear through ankle-deep mud for a quarter mile. Once there, we discovered the fire ring had been left full of soggy, half-burned trash from previous campers. The camp store, advertised as fully stocked, sold nothing but expired snacks and warm soda. When a storm rolled in that night, the flimsy lean-to shelter did nothing to keep our supplies dry.
label: negative

text: Some of the modern art installations were clever, especially the mirrored room on the second floor. Unfortunately the elevator to that floor was broken and my grandmother, who uses a cane, had to be helped up two flights of stairs by a stranger since staff seemed unaware or unbothered. We left before seeing the rest of the collection because she was too exhausted.
label: negative

text: Buffering hiccuped during the first ten minutes of the finale, annoying but whatever, it cleared right up. The 4K on that nature documentary made every feather look individually lit, and the soundtrack synced so well I forgot I was on my couch and not in the Serengeti. Downloaded three seasons for a flight and barely touched my data plan the whole trip.
label: positive

text: honestly disappointed, the components smell weird straight out of the box like some chemical glue smell that hasnt gone away after a week. gameplay wise the third act just drags, you can see the ending coming from a mile away and theres no tension left. wont be bringing this back to the table
label: negative

text: It ran a little hot during the first extended steam cycle, enough that the kitchen felt noticeably warmer afterward, though that settled down with later use. What stuck with me was the texture of the sticky rice for mango sticky rice night, glossy and clumped just right for eating with my hands, better than three restaurants I've tried. The pot's handles stay put even when full and heavy, no wobbling during transport from stove to table, and the seal around the lid has held tight through months of near-daily use without any warping.
label: positive

text: Three of us split a bucket of Korean fried chicken and there wasn't a single piece left soggy by the time it reached us, even the ones at the bottom. The gochujang glaze had that sticky-sweet-spicy balance that's hard to nail, and pickled radish cubes came included without us requesting them. Driver was friendly enough to wish us a good night through the door, small touch but it stuck with me.
label: positive

text: Picked this up at a used bookstore because of the cover art and honestly didn't expect much, yet the dialogue between the old lighthouse keeper and the runaway kid felt so real I forgot I was reading fiction. The ending punched me right in the gut in the best way. Already lent my copy to two coworkers.
label: positive

text: Went with my sister to the bank heist room and cracking the vault using a laser maze puzzle was genuinely thrilling. The actor playing the security guard added just enough chaos without breaking immersion. We fumbled the final wire-cutting step twice, but the staff's playful countdown announcements kept the energy high.
label: positive

text: Their original shows are genuinely well-written, I'll give them that much. The bigger issue is the price jump they snuck in last month with just a vague email about 'enhanced content investment.' My bill went up eleven bucks and the customer chat bot just looped the same canned response when I asked why.
label: negative

text: The weight capacity claim held up fine when I stacked a printer, monitor, and stack of textbooks on one side. Transitioning between heights takes under ten seconds, which makes it easy to switch positions without breaking focus. Packaging was excessive with foam everywhere, but at least nothing arrived dinged.
label: positive

text: estimate they gave over email didnt quite match what showed up on paper, off by maybe thirty bucks, not a huge deal in the end. what stuck with me was the mechanic crawling underneath to show me the actual rusted subframe bolt causing the vibration, then torquing everything to spec while i watched on my phone timer just to see how careful he was being. left with the steering wheel finally feeling solid on the highway home
label: positive

text: Sound stays crisp even at low volumes, which is rare, and calls come through clear enough that my sister thought I was on speakerphone in a quiet room. Touch controls are a little finicky, sometimes a tap registers as two. Pairing with my laptop happens instantly now, no more digging through Bluetooth menus at 7am.
label: positive

text: The particular puzzle involving the compass and the map felt like it had one too many red herrings, and we spent nearly ten minutes turning dials that did nothing at all. That frustration mostly evaporated once we reached the captain's quarters, where the floor genuinely tilted beneath our feet and a wall of fog rolled out just as the treasure chest creaked open under shifting golden light, coins spilling across the boards in a way that made two of us actually gasp.
label: positive

text: I showed up at 7am for my 8am lesson and stood in a line that didn't move for forty minutes because only one person was working the boot counter. When I finally got fitted, the boots they gave me had a cracked buckle on the left one that I didn't notice until I was already on the lift. The gloves I rented smelled like mildew and had a hole in the thumb. For $95 I expected at least functional gear.
label: negative

text: I work construction and my phone takes a beating daily. This case has survived being buried in drywall dust, dropped from a ladder at about 8 feet, and stepped on by my coworker Dave.
