Grip is excellent even with gloves on. Ordered it for $22 and it's paid for itself in cracked-screen prevention alone.
label: positive

text: Chapter three's breakdown of supply and demand curves used real 2019 housing market data, which made the concepts click for me in a way textbooks never did. The instructor's voice is easy to listen to at 1.5x speed too. On the other hand, this $199 course caps video playback at 480p on mobile, a limitation nowhere mentioned on the sales page, and the charts showing regression lines are essentially illegible on a phone screen. I contacted support through the chat widget and was told this is 'by design to reduce server costs.' Attempting to follow along with graphs that blur into gray smudges turned what should have been a fifteen-minute lesson into a forty-minute exercise in squinting.
label: negative

text: booked a cabin for the overnight crossing and the bed was surprisingly comfortable, better than i expected honestly. the shower in the cabin barely had any water pressure though, more of a light drizzle really, and when i called reception about it they just said 'yeah thats normal for this route' which wasnt reassuring. breakfast the next morning was included and had a decent spread, thats a plus. but the announcement system kept going off at random hours overnight, waking everyone up with irrelevant safety drills that could've easily waited till morning
label: negative

text: the ac works great which matters a lot in summer, gotta give them that. downside is every single machine i wanted to use last week had an 'out of order' sign taped to it with masking tape thats been there since february probably. three treadmills down, one leg press down, and the app still shows the gym as 'fully equipped.' also parking lot lights are out so leaving after a night class feels sketchy honestly
label: negative

text: ok so the color is exactly like the pics, this deep forest green that actually looks kinda expensive. camera cutout lines up fine too. but three weeks in and the corners are already peeling up like a bad sticker, and dropped it once from like waist height and the whole back panel cracked in a spiderweb pattern. glue smell hasn't gone away either, still get a whiff of it when i pull it out of my pocket
label: negative

text: Some of the character powers are clearly stronger than others, my friend's rogue basically broke the early game wide open. Still, the storytelling branches were so clever that we forgot about balance and just kept narrating our own side quests out loud. The final boss encounter had my roommate literally standing up out of his chair.
label: positive

text: For $50, the button replacements on my winter coat looked identical to the originals, which impressed me at first. But the zipper he installed afterward snags constantly, catching fabric every time I pull it past the collar, and it's done that since day one. I mentioned it while still in the shop and he said zippers 'need breaking in,' which after three weeks still hasn't happened. The receipt he handed me was even neatly itemized, for what little that's worth now.
label: negative

text: The salmon fillets arrived on ice, perfectly fresh, and the teriyaki glaze packet was genuinely tasty. Tuesday's box, though, showed up at 9pm instead of the promised noon window, and I'd already eaten cereal for dinner. Thursday's box had a torn bag of snap peas leaking water into the cardboard, soaking through to the cilantro packet underneath, turning it to mush. Customer service took four days to respond to my email about the $67.99 charge for a box I never got to use properly.
label: negative

text: Needed an emergency repair on a blazer button an hour before a client meeting, and the tailor at Grand Avenue Cleaners fixed it free of charge in ten minutes. He also tightened a loose thread on the cuff without me asking. Small gesture, but it turned a stressful morning into a good one.
label: positive

text: charging case looks sleek, fits in my pocket without a bulge. one earbud though developed this faint static hiss after maybe two weeks, only in quiet parts of songs but once i noticed it i couldnt unnotice it. contacted support and they just said try cleaning the contacts, didnt fix anything. sound otherwise is fine when theres no hiss i suppose, mids are decent
label: negative

text: Parking behind the shop is tight and I scraped my mirror on the fence trying to squeeze in. Once inside though, the groomer, Dave, spent almost two hours on my sheepdog's undercoat, brushing out clumps I'd been ignoring for months, and charged me the standard sixty-five even though it clearly took him way longer than usual. My dog walked out looking like an entirely different animal, lighter, bouncier, practically strutting to the car.
label: positive

text: The 1500-watt element in this kettle brings a full liter to a rolling boil in just under three minutes, which has completely changed my morning coffee routine. I clocked it with a stopwatch out of curiosity and was genuinely surprised. The auto shutoff clicks off with a satisfying snap rather than an abrupt jolt, and the handle stays cool even after back-to-back boils for tea and then oatmeal water. One small gripe is that the lid release button is a bit stiff, but that's a fair trade for how sturdy the hinge feels.
label: positive

text: My mother is seventy-eight and has arthritis in both hands, so weight was my biggest concern when shopping for her. This unit comes in under four pounds in handheld mode, and she's been able to manage the stairs without help for the first time in years. The headlights on the nozzle also help her spot debris in dim hallways, which she mentioned unprompted, so I know it's actually useful and not just a gimmick.
label: positive

text: waited almost forty five minutes past my appointment time bc he was finishing someone elses fitting. kind of annoying ngl. but the moment i put on my altered coat i forgot about the wait, the way he tapered the waist without touching the shoulders was some next level tailoring, and he hand finished the buttonholes so they look like they came off a bespoke rack. even fixed a small tear near the pocket for free.
label: positive

text: Six of us descended on this place for a Saturday study group and they somehow accommodated our chaos without a single eye roll. The communal table has this reclaimed wood texture that photographs beautifully, and someone in our group knocked over a drink and staff handled it with actual grace instead of the usual passive-aggressive sighing. Their drip coffee, sourced from a farm in Huehuetenango according to the chalkboard, had bright citrus notes that woke me right up. Parking out back is tight, but that's a minor issue.
label: positive

text: We showed up for the special exhibit only to discover it required a separate ticket that wasn't mentioned anywhere on the museum's own homepage. The elevator to the third floor was out, which meant my grandmother had to skip half the collection entirely since there were no ramps or alternate routes. Frustrating way to spend a Saturday.
label: negative

text: They left a smudge of grease on the top tube that took some effort to wipe off. Everything else about the service made up for it though, especially the way the derailleur now shifts through the full range without a single skip or hesitation. New brake pads bite instantly in the rain, tested that on the ride home through a light drizzle, and the wheels spin with barely a sound, like riding on rails.
label: positive

text: There's a rattly noise the lid makes right before it switches to warm mode, something I noticed within the first week and haven't quite gotten used to. That aside, the timer function let me set rice to finish exactly when I got home from a 6pm shift, and it was still hot and properly textured at 6:45 after I got stuck in traffic. The rice paddle holder on the side doesn't stick well and has fallen off twice. I've made basmati for a dinner party of eight guests using this, and three people asked what brand it was. Water measurement lines inside the pot are a little faint and hard to see under kitchen lighting.
label: positive

text: I ordered the salmon and found a small piece of plastic wrap cooked right into the glaze, which killed my appetite for the rest of the meal. The manager offered a 10% discount as if that made up for finding foreign material in my dinner. Prices here are already steep for portions the size of a child's plate, so the whole night felt like a waste of money.
label: negative

text: Rows of speckled quail eggs sat beside jars of tupelo honey, and the woman running the booth explained the difference between spring and fall harvests without me even asking. I left with three jars and a recipe scrawled on a napkin for honey-glazed carrots. The only downside was the cash-only policy, which sent me sprinting to the ATM two blocks away.
label: positive

text: The opening puzzle with the UV flashlight was a genuinely cool touch, but then our game master's radio cut out for a solid fifteen minutes and we just sat there staring at a locked drawer, completely stuck with no hints coming through. Sure, the set design in the second room was gorgeous with all those hanging vines, but that dead air killed all our momentum and we never really recovered.
label: negative

text: the bathroom needed some attention, sink was clogged when i went in. but they nailed my order exactly how i described it, cinnamon dusted cappuccino with extra foam, and the barista even remembered i dont like it too hot. the outdoor seating area has these string lights that come on around dusk and its such a chill vibe to just sit outside and people watch for a while
label: positive

text: Reception area had this great little themed snack bar, small detail but it set a fun mood before we even started. The escape room itself had a satisfying puzzle involving a music box that we solved with zero help, felt genuinely proud of that one. Then the final sequence needed a specific order of levers that the instructions described ambiguously, and after burning ten minutes second-guessing ourselves we just had the door unlocked for us with barely an explanation of what we'd missed.
label: negative

text: the shop smells like mothballs and the guy barely says two words to you when you walk in. price went up a bit from what he quoted on the phone too. but i brought him a jacket with a torn lining and he rebuilt the whole inside with this deep burgundy silk, stitched so clean you'd think it came that way from the factory. buttons were reinforced too, doubled thread so they wont pop off in six months like the last place.
label: positive

text: The onboard shop had a decent selection of local wine, cheaper than the ports on either side. Our assigned seats, purchased as reserved recliners for the Helsinki to Tallinn crossing, turned out to be broken, reclining backward on their own every few minutes for the full two hours. Complaints to staff got a shrug and a suggestion to sit elsewhere, though every other recliner in that section had the same issue. The wine selection, at least, lived up to its reputation.
label: negative

text: I'll give them this: the online scheduling system is smooth, and I got a text reminder the morning of my appointment which is more than I can say for my old dentist. Inside, though, the exam room was freezing, and nobody offered a blanket despite me visibly shivering through the whole cleaning. The bigger issue came at checkout, where the receptionist quoted me a co-pay that was $60 higher than what my insurance portal shows as my actual responsibility, and when I pushed back she just shrugged and said "that's what the system generated." I paid it to avoid a scene, but I'm still annoyed I didn't push harder, especially since resolving billing discrepancies apparently isn't anyone's job there.
label: negative

text: The showers were lukewarm at best and the gravel lot fills up fast, but our site backed right onto the creek and we fell asleep to actual running water instead of traffic noise. Woke up to mist rolling over the pines and coffee never tasted better than it did on that picnic table. Kids caught crawdads for two hours straight without asking for the iPad once.
label: positive

text: Turbulence aside, the real problem was the overhead bin situation—half of them were already crammed with crew luggage so passengers were stuffing bags under every seat. My headphone jack in the seat didn't work and the entertainment screen froze on the safety video for the whole flight. Small thing but it added up to a pretty miserable four hours.
label: negative

text: Beer prices are up there, obviously, that's just how it goes at these places now. The stage design though, with those hanging light panels that moved with the music, turned the whole room into something else entirely. Left humming the setlist the whole drive home, still buzzing from that light show.
label: positive

text: The website said walk-ins welcome but when I arrived they told me I needed a reservation, even though there were clearly open racks of skis behind the counter. After arguing for ten minutes they finally rented to me, but charged an extra $20 'convenience fee' that was never mentioned anywhere online. The poles they gave me were bent at an angle that made them nearly useless on hardpack.
label: negative

text: I'll admit the de-shedding treatment worked wonders, my lab mix left way less fur around the house for at least a week afterward. The groomer was friendly enough during drop-off, chatting about breed-specific coat types like she really knew her stuff. Then I got home and found a rough patch on his tail where the clippers had clearly slipped, uneven and a little raw looking, plus a persistent smell of something chemical that lingered on his fur for two days despite the supposed 'all-natural' shampoo they used. Calling to ask about it just got me a vague apology and no real explanation.
label: negative

text: I liked how packable it was, stuffing down into a bag about the size of a grapefruit for travel. The DWR coating gave up almost immediately though, and by the fourth outing water was just sheeting across the shoulders instead of beading up like it's supposed to. I re-treated it with a wash-in waterproofer, which helped for exactly one hike before it reverted to soaking through. The chest pocket zipper also snags every single time I try to close it, catching on the storm flap fabric in a way that's impossible to fix without pliers. Packability only matters if the thing keeps you dry once you unpack it.
label: negative

text: texture on the back is slightly grainy which i didn't expect from the photos, kind of a minor surprise but not a dealbreaker at all. what sold me is how this case handled getting run over by my own car tire when it fell out of my pocket in the driveway, the case cracked a bit at one corner but the phone itself walked away completely unscathed. the magnetic mount compatibility is seamless too, snaps onto my car vent with a satisfying click every time and never falls off on bumpy roads
label: positive

text: some of the listening exercises have audio that's clearly recorded in someone's bedroom, echoey and kinda hard to parse ngl. and the vocab quizzes repeat words i already know way too often. that said the pronunciation feedback for korean has been genuinely wild, it caught that i was mixing up ㅅ and ㅆ sounds for weeks and walked me through mouth positioning with actual video overlays until i finally heard the difference myself last tuesday
label: positive

text: Sure, the office smelled like fresh coffee and the waiting area had those comfy chairs. Then again I sat in one of those chairs for fifty extra minutes because they double-booked my slot, and when I finally got in, the preparer forgot to ask about my side gig income until I brought it up myself.
label: negative

text: Edge cleaning along baseboards works better than my old Bissell, no complaints there. The swivel steering is genuinely smooth on turns. Where things fall apart is the weight, this thing is 17 pounds and hauling it up to my second floor bedroom twice a week has become a small workout I didn't sign up for. The handle also creaked within the first month and now makes a groaning noise every time I push it forward, loud enough that my cat bolts from the room. On top of that, the attachment for upholstery snapped off after maybe six uses, just cracked at the plastic joint, and customer service quoted me $22 plus shipping for a replacement part that should've been sturdier from the start.
label: negative

text: Celebrated my mom's retirement here and the staff pulled out all the stops. They rearranged two tables to fit our group of eleven without complaint and kept the kids' chicken tenders coming fast. The mushroom tortellini in brown butter sage sauce stole the show for me—rich but not heavy. Noise level got a bit loud once the place filled up, but nobody in our party minded given how much fun we were having.
label: positive

text: Their online quote tool lowballed the price by almost two hundred dollars, which stung when the final bill came. Communication leading up to moving day was spotty too, with two unreturned calls. Still, the actual move was something else. Marcus, the lead guy, mapped out the elevator reservation at my building down to the minute so we never lost a slot, and his team wrapped every mirror and framed print in double layers of foam before stacking them upright in a custom-built cardboard sleeve. They found a way to angle my sectional couch through a doorway that two previous movers had told me was impossible without disassembly. By the time they left, my new apartment looked more organized than my old one ever did.
label: positive

text: Shipping arrived a day late and the box had a small dent on one corner, cosmetic but slightly worrying when you're paying this much. The moment I unrolled it, though, the foam expanded faster than I expected, fully ready by the next morning instead of the 48 hours the site warned about. My grandmother, who visited and tried it out on a whim, said her arthritis-riddled hips felt better after one nap than after weeks on her own bed. The firmness is on the higher end, which took some adjusting if, like me, you're used to a plush pillow-top. Now that I'm used to it, I notice I fall asleep faster, usually within minutes of lying down, something that used to take me the better part of an hour.
label: positive

text: Snugness of the fit is impressive, no gaps at the edges and the ports line up perfectly with no shadowing around the flash. It survived a spill of coffee across the back without a stain, which surprised me. But the clear back panel, the main reason I bought this one, started bubbling along the seams around month three, little air pockets forming under the plastic like it's peeling from the inside out. Now there's a permanent cloudy patch spreading from the bottom left corner that makes the phone look like it's been through a wash cycle.
label: negative

text: battery backup lasted through a power outage which impressed me not gonna lie. thing is the touchscreen is so laggy you gotta tap it 3-4 times before it registers, and twice now it just froze on a loading spinner and i had to pull it off the wall and reset it manually. customer support chat kept me waiting 40 min then told me to reinstall the app, didnt fix anything. energy report graphs are kinda cool to look at at least.
label: negative

text: Our reserved spot backed directly onto the generator shed for the camp store, which ran from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. without pause. Earplugs didn't help over the diesel hum, and the smell of exhaust drifted straight into our tent whenever the wind shifted. Requested a refund and was denied.
label: negative

text: The wait was longer than expected since Marcy ran behind by almost forty minutes on a Saturday morning. My terrier came out with the cleanest, most even trim I've seen from any groomer in town, and they even buffed his nails smooth so he stopped scratching the hardwood. The lavender shampoo smell lingered on him for days in the best way. Paid thirty-eight dollars, which felt fair once I saw how they'd shaped his ears to match his face.
label: positive

text: Ticket said timed entry at 11:15 but the line moved so slowly we didn't get in until nearly noon, cutting our visit short since we had a train to catch. The modern art wing was freezing, like actively uncomfortable, and I saw at least two other families leave early because of it. Charged $6 for a locker that ate my quarter and never opened. Overall a frustrating morning at the Bellmore Art Institute.
label: negative

text: The color matching on my business cards came out nearly perfect, which I appreciated since my logo has a tricky teal. But I waited fifty minutes past my pickup time because the guy at the counter couldn't find my order in the system, then discovered a stack of my flyers stuck together with wet ink smearing across the top corner. He offered to redo just the smeared ones, not the whole batch, and I ended up trimming the damaged edges myself with scissors at home.
label: negative

text: They squeezed me in same-day for a cracked molar, which saved my week. The dentist barely looked up from his tablet the whole time and mumbled through the aftercare instructions so fast I had to ask twice. Two days later I'm still getting texts about a follow-up appointment I never scheduled.
label: negative

text: The opening chapter hooks you immediately, a strong image of the burning barn that stuck with me for days. From there the author leans hard on flashbacks, sometimes three per chapter, and by the halfway point I'd lost track of what year we were even in. The romantic subplot between Dale and the schoolteacher feels tacked on, introduced late and resolved in a single paragraph. My paperback, purchased secondhand for six dollars, had a printing error on page 145 where the same paragraph repeats twice, and it wasn't just my copy according to online reviews.
label: negative

text: I've taken plenty of MOOCs, and this is the first where the downloadable spreadsheets actually matched the video timestamps exactly. The section on regression diagnostics included a dataset from an actual retail chain, which made the residual plots feel less abstract. Audio dipped slightly during lecture nine, but the transcript caught everything, and I passed the capstone with a 94.
label: positive

text: They were out of oat milk, which threw off my order and forced me into a substitution I hadn't planned on, and the register system seemed to be running on borrowed time given how long it took to process a simple card payment. But the mocha they handed me was rich with real shaved chocolate on top, not that powdered stuff, and the whipped cream held its shape long after I'd finished half the cup. A stack of well-worn board games sat on a shelf near the window, and my sister and I ended up playing checkers for nearly an hour, ignoring our phones entirely. The chairs, admittedly, were the hard wooden kind that make your back ache after a while, but the low hum of conversation around us and the smell of fresh-baked banana bread coming from the kitchen made it easy to forget the discomfort.
label: positive

text: Two guys showed up to move a three-bedroom house, despite being told a week in advance that we'd booked a four-person crew, and they spent most of the day looking exhausted and cutting corners on wrapping furniture. My leather sofa arrived with a long scuff mark down one arm, and the movers just shrugged when I pointed it out, saying it 'probably happened before.' By the end of the ten-hour ordeal, I was helping carry boxes myself just to get them out the door before dark.
label: negative

text: My kickstand finally stopped collapsing under light pressure, which was satisfying to notice immediately. But three days later the crankset started making this rhythmic clunk with every pedal stroke, a sound that wasn't there before I dropped it off for the tune-up. When I called, they told me it was unrelated and probably a coincidence, which felt dismissive given the timing. The headset was also left loose enough that the front wheel now shimmies slightly at speed, something I have to consciously correct for on every downhill stretch near my house.
label: negative

text: They only take cash or Venmo, no cards, which caught me off guard at checkout. Priya spent close to two hours on my balayage, painting each section by hand rather than using a cap, and the transition from my roots to the ends looks like it grew that way naturally. The lobby music was some kind of smooth jazz loop that got a little repetitive by hour two. When she rinsed it out and the color caught the light near the window, a woman waiting for her own appointment asked where I'd gotten it done.
label: positive

text: my headphones jack didnt work so i couldnt use the entertainment system, kinda bummed about that. but the guy next to me and i ended up talking the whole flight cause the crew kept the vibe relaxed and chill, not rushing anyone. free wifi surprised me, worked better than some hotels ive stayed at. turbulence hit for a bit near the end but the flight attendants stayed so calm walking the aisle it didnt even feel scary. touched down right as the sun was coming up, whole cabin lit orange
label: positive

text: Setup and communication before the move were smooth, and the invoice they sent over matched what we discussed, no surprises there. The day of, though, the driver backed the truck into my neighbor's fence trying to angle into the driveway, and it took him almost forty minutes of maneuvering while my furniture sat exposed to the sun. Once they got inside, I noticed my TV, which I'd specifically asked to be crated, was just wrapped in a moving blanket, and the corner of the screen now has a hairline crack running through it. When I brought it up, the foreman just shrugged and said the crate would've cost extra anyway.
label: negative

text: Shipping took an extra three days past the estimate, which had me checking the tracking page way too often. When the box finally showed up though, the hydrangea inside was in full bud with these huge green leaves, not a single wilted one. It's already outgrown the spot I picked for it and I'm scrambling to find it a bigger corner of the yard.
label: positive

text: My experience with this moving service left me furious for days afterward. The estimate I received over the phone was nearly half of what I was ultimately charged, with fees for wrapping blankets, an extra flight of stairs, and something labeled only as a 'handling surcharge' that no one could explain when I asked. One of the movers also lost a small toolbox that had been sitting near the front door, and despite my description matching exactly what disappeared, the company denied responsibility outright. The whole ordeal felt less like a professional service and more like a gamble I lost.
label: negative

text: New grips feel great in my palms, soft and grippy in the rain even. That part I won't complain about. The real issue is the rear derailleur hanger, which they apparently bent further while adjusting the limit screws, so now the chain skips violently between fourth and fifth gear on any incline. I mentioned this to the guy at pickup and he just shrugged and said it needed a hanger replacement, an extra charge they never disclosed upfront. The brake levers also feel spongier than before, requiring me to squeeze nearly to the bar to get any stopping power on my commute home.
label: negative

text: dropped the car off at 8am and mike had it up on the lift within ten minutes, showed me exactly where the exhaust was rusted through and let me keep the old part. yeah the front desk guy quoted me wrong on the phone the day before, kinda annoying, but watching them weld in the new section and hearing that purr when it started back up made up for it big time
label: positive

text: The poles I received had rubber grips peeling off in strips, leaving my palms raw by lunchtime. Return procedures were just as bad: despite dropping the equipment off ten minutes before closing, I got a late fee charged to my card the next day with zero warning. When I called to dispute it, the manager repeated store policy at me like a recording instead of actually listening to what happened.
label: negative

text: Setting expectations too high from the reviews probably didn't help, and I did notice the mattress runs a touch firmer than the 'medium' label suggested, especially in the first month before it broke in. That said, the way it handles my restless leg syndrome at night — no springing coils poking through, no creaks — has been the real story here. There's a barely noticeable seam along the cover's edge that catches your finger if you run it along there, purely cosmetic. My partner's chronic tossing used to wake me constantly on our old bed; here I sleep through it, morning after morning, like the mattress just absorbs the whole event. Even the packaging, awkward as it was to break down for recycling, felt like a small price for how it's changed my mornings.
label: positive

text: The touchscreen is responsive and the display looks great next to my light switches, matching the brushed nickel finish nicely. Unfortunately the battery compartment corroded within four months, something the manual never mentioned as a risk, and I only caught it because the display started flickering. Replacing the unit cost me another $180 since it was just outside the 90-day return window by eleven days. Nice looking device, but I'm now leery of trusting it near any humidity at all.
label: negative

text: Took my toddler in for his first real haircut and they had a tiny superhero cape ready for him, which made the whole thing way less traumatic. The stylist worked fast around his wiggling and even gave him a lollipop after. We'll definitely be regulars now that he associates haircuts with good memories.
label: positive

text: Packaging on the citrus tree was impressive, a wooden crate lined with shredded paper, stake ties keeping the trunk from shifting. The tree itself leafed out within a week, which I wasn't expecting so fast. Then I noticed small white cottony clusters along the underside of three leaves — mealybugs, as it turned out — and by the time I'd isolated the tree from my other plants, two of them had picked up the infestation too. Spraying neem oil every few days for a month became part of my routine, and I still see the occasional straggler colony tucked near the stem.
label: negative

text: Poles were included free with the package, which saved me a few bucks. The bindings on my rental skis, though, released twice on flat terrain for no reason at all, once sending me face first into a snowbank in front of a school group. I brought it up to the kid working the desk and he just re-tightened them with a shrug like it happens all the time. Not exactly reassuring when you're paying seventy dollars a day for gear that's supposed to keep you attached to your skis.
label: negative

text: ok so the color is actually really pretty in person, like a deep sage green that matched my expectations from the photos. but three weeks in and the corner by the charging port straight up cracked after a drop from like knee height, not even a real fall. camera bump also doesnt line up perfect so theres this weird halo of dust that gets trapped around the lens every single day and i have to dig it out with a toothpick.

text: The waiting area chairs are kind of uncomfortable and there's no real space to sit with a big dog, so my lab and I stood by the door for a bit. I checked online and apparently that corner is a known weak point on this model, which would've been nice to know before I paid for it.
label: negative

text: I scheduled a fitting for a bridesmaid dress alteration and stood there for forty minutes past my appointment time while the staff helped walk-in customers ahead of me. label: negative

text: The initial comfort was genuinely impressive, plush enough on top without feeling like quicksand, and my shoulder pain eased for the first month. Since then, though, I've measured an indentation of almost an inch and a half where I normally sleep, using an actual tape measure because I didn't believe it at first. Heat retention has also crept up, which is strange since it's marketed as a cooling hybrid. Customer service at Casper took eleven days to even respond to my email about the sagging, and the reply just linked me back to the warranty page.
label: negative

text: The croissant was buttery and clearly fresh from the oven, which is more than I can say for the rest of the visit. My cold brew tasted watered down, like the ice had melted long before it reached me. The music was fine at first but looped the same four songs on repeat the entire forty minutes I sat there, and by the end I was humming it against my will on the walk home.
label: negative

text: Our neighbors were loud the first night, which happens I guess when sites are close together. text: Their vocabulary lists sometimes include words so obscure I doubt native speakers use them daily, and the review sessions can drag if you're only trying to learn survival phrases before a trip. label: positive

text: Their matcha latte was smooth and not too sweet, a rare find these days. The floor near the milk station was slick with spilled milk, and I nearly slipped carrying my tray to a seat.

text: Setup involved more driver updates than I expected, a small time sink on day one. But the keyboard layout — full-size arrow keys, dedicated Home and End, a numpad that doesn't feel cramped — turned out to matter more day to day than I anticipated, and spreadsheet work that used to require constant mouse clicks now flows through keystrokes alone.

text: Billing added a fifteen dollar fuel surcharge nobody mentioned upfront, still the driver navigated a narrow city alley I didn't think a truck could fit through and got the piano inside without a scratch.

Sandra remembered from last time that he hates the dryer noise and used a towel-dry instead, which took longer but he wasn't shaking the whole visit.
