text: There's a certain charm to the old-fashioned brass railings on this vessel, and the gift shop had some genuinely good local honey. But the crossing itself was rough enough that half the outdoor deck chairs had slid into each other by the halfway point, and nobody had bothered to anchor them despite forecasts predicting swells. The queue for the single working card machine at the café stretched the length of the corridor, and I watched at least a dozen people give up and go hungry rather than wait. Wifi promised in the brochure didn't connect at any point during the ninety-minute ride, which wouldn't matter except we'd paid extra for the 'premium' cabin specifically advertising it.
label: negative

text: Lecture six's breakdown of amortized analysis was sharp, genuinely one of the better explanations I've encountered, complete with a whiteboard diagram I screenshotted for later. Past that point, the course structure fell apart. The promised 'lifetime access' advertised on the sales page turned into 'access for 12 months' buried in section 9 of the terms, which I only found after my login stopped working in month thirteen. Peer review assignments required grading three classmates' work, but the platform assigned me submissions in a language I don't read, with no way to request a swap. Email support, run through a third-party ticketing system, closed my case as 'resolved' twice without any actual reply, and the second time I had to reopen it by filing an entirely new ticket from scratch.
label: negative

text: Fan noise kicks in under load, sure, but that keyboard travel and the way the 4K panel renders deep reds makes every editing session feel like butter.
label: positive

text: It glides beautifully across carpet, gliding is really the only word, smooth and quiet compared to my old upright. That said, the cord is barely fifteen feet long, so I'm constantly unplugging and replugging to get down the hallway, and the plug itself runs hot to the touch after twenty minutes of use. The instruction manual doesn't even mention this, which felt like an oversight worth flagging to the manufacturer.
label: negative

text: Cleaning the little steam vent cap takes more scrubbing than I'd like, but there's something satisfying about lifting the lid to see rice that's uniformly cooked edge to edge, no crunchy bits hiding at the bottom like my old pot used to leave.
label: positive

text: Went with Wightlink from Portsmouth to Fishbourne on a Tuesday afternoon, £54 for the car including two passengers. Forty-minute crossing, smooth as anything, and my kids loved watching the Isle of Wight come into view from the upper deck. Snack bar had reasonably priced hot chocolate at £2.80. Terminal parking was easy to find too. Genuinely one of the more pleasant short crossings I've done.
label: positive

text: Never thought I'd get excited about a kitchen appliance but here we are. The boil-dry protection saved me once when I forgot to add water, no damage done and no burning smell either. Plus the matte finish hides fingerprints way better than the glossy one I had before.
label: positive

text: The map at the front is a nice touch and helped me track the journey initially, but the middle third abandons the quest entirely for a lengthy political subplot involving councils I never got straight, and the paper stock is thin enough that ink bleeds through from the other side.
label: negative

text: The queue outside stretched past the fountain and it took forty minutes to get past the ticket counter at 10am. Once inside, though, the Egyptian wing swallowed the wait completely — the sarcophagus of Nefer-something glowed under the low amber lighting, and a docent named Rosa spent twenty unhurried minutes explaining the hieroglyphs on a coffin lid nobody else had stopped for. The gift shop was cramped and overpriced, six dollars for a postcard. Rosa's tour ended near the mummified cat display, and I stood there for another fifteen minutes just looking.
label: positive

text: Instructions on the pad thai were confusing about pan temperature, had to guess a bit. The tamarind sauce packet made up for it completely with a tangy sweetness that coated the noodles perfectly, and the crushed peanuts on top gave every bite crunch. I've already put in a request for that one again next week.
label: positive

text: One of the three movers seemed new and kept asking the others where things went, which slowed the loading process down. The lead mover, a woman named Angela, more than made up for it by personally wrapping every mirror and framed painting in bubble wrap and cardboard sandwiches before they touched the truck. They used moving straps to carry my refrigerator up a flight of stairs instead of a dolly, which seemed nerve-wracking until I saw how steady they kept it. My cost came out about thirty dollars higher than quoted because of the extra weight from my book boxes. Everything got placed in the correct rooms without a single piece of furniture left in the wrong spot, down to my desk facing the window exactly like I'd asked.
label: positive

text: Took a bit longer than the quoted hour, closer to ninety minutes while I waited in the lobby. But watching them adjust the derailleur hanger alignment was oddly satisfying, and afterward the gears clicked into place with zero hesitation, first try every time. They also topped off the tire pressure and swapped a frayed brake cable that I hadn't even mentioned, which now grips hard the instant I squeeze the lever.

text: Ordered a large pepperoni and got a small cheese instead. Took 90 minutes to arrive and was already cold. Not doing that again.

text: booked a nonsmoking room and it reeked of cigarettes, opened the window and it barely helped. bathroom fan sounded like a jet engine and the fridge hummed loud enough to keep me up. definitely not worth what we paid

text: The export-to-PDF feature alone justified the subscription price for my freelance invoicing.

text: The escape sequence finale, where a wall panel slides open to reveal a corridor, is a genuinely cool payoff mechanically. A padlock on the final chest also had numbers so scratched off that two of us stood there running our fingers over grooves trying to guess digits. Booking was $28 a person online. The soundtrack cue when the panel finally opened was satisfying, at least, even if it came six minutes later than it should have.

text: Paperwork took forever and I had to call twice to confirm the date, sure. Once the truck pulled up though, four guys had my whole apartment loaded in ninety minutes flat, stacking boxes like a game of Tetris. My dishes arrived without so much as a chip.

text: Baggage claim in Phoenix took nearly fifty minutes, which had half the plane grumbling by the carousel. That said, the actual flight down from Seattle was smooth as glass, and the pilot, Captain Reyes, timed our descent so we caught the sunset over the Grand Canyon rim, an announcement he made just in time for window seats to get their phones up. My seatmate and I split a bag of the cinnamon pretzel thins they still hand out, and the extra legroom seat I paid $35 to upgrade into made the four hours feel like nothing at all.
label: positive

text: Ear tips kept slipping out during my morning runs no matter which size I swapped in. Ended up chasing one down the sidewalk after it flew out mid-jog. Not worth the hassle for something marketed as workout friendly.

text: Ordered these JBL Tune Buds on March 3rd expecting mediocre sound at $49, but the mids and highs are surprisingly balanced for podcasts. text: Loading the car went smoothly, and the ramp crew in Dover moved vehicles efficiently despite the queue. text: Initial calibration was off by about three degrees for the first week, so the house felt colder than the display claimed, which was mildly infuristating during a cold snap. Even the click of the relay switching on has a satisfying, solid sound compared to the flimsy clack of the old dial thermostat.

text: I'll admit the children's programming kept my toddler occupied longer than I expected, with shows clearly designed by people who understand attention spans. Call quality on a windy walk through Fisherman's Wharf came through clear enough that my mom didn't ask me to repeat myself once. Fit stays snug during runs, which is the main reason I bought them.
label: positive

text: Room smelled like a mix of mildew and old cigarettes even though it was labeled non-smoking. The mini fridge hummed loud enough to keep me up half the night. On top of that they charged a random 'resort fee' for amenities that clearly didn't exist.
label: negative

text: Bought this for my daughter's soccer games and it's held up through mud, rain, and being crammed into her backpack constantly. The seams haven't leaked once despite some rough treatment. Even after washing it a dozen times the waterproofing hasn't degraded at all.
label: positive

text: checked in online in like 90 seconds, smoothest process ive had in years. pilot gave a shoutout to a passenger celebrating their anniversary which got the whole row clapping. only gripe is the ac was blasting cold near row 22 but blanket fixed that quick
label: positive

text: I had to reschedule twice because their booking system glitched on me. When I finally got in, the balayage placement was so precise it looked like sunlight naturally hit my hair in exactly the right spots, and the stylist threw in a scalp treatment that left my roots tingling in the best way. Everyone at work asked where I disappeared to get my hair done.
label: positive

text: The height range is generous, tall enough for my six-foot-four frame without tiptoeing. Cable management tray in the back snapped one of its plastic clips on day three though, and now wires just dangle and catch my foot under the desk. I also found a long scratch across the surface that wasn't there when I unboxed it.
label: negative

text: My daughter Rosie picked this out for her iPhone 13 in the translucent teal color. Two months in and the corners still bounce back after falls off her bunk bed. The only downside is the buttons feel slightly mushy, but that's a small trade-off for the protection it offers.
label: positive

text: Boiled a full liter in just under 3 minutes, which beats my old stovetop kettle by a mile. The auto shut-off kicked in exactly when it should, and at $34.99 on sale, I can't complain. Only gripe is the cord's a bit short.
label: positive

text: The exam room smelled like mildew, and the paper covering on the chair had a visible stain from the last patient.
label: negative

text: Boarding got delayed almost forty minutes with zero explanation, which tested my patience standing in the heat. But once we finally pulled out, the spray off the bow felt amazing and the crew let a few of us stand near the front for photos as the wake fanned out behind us in these perfect white curves. The vending machine ate my money, sure, but that hour of watching cormorants dive near the rocks made it easy to forget about the wait entirely.
label: positive

text: Character actors popping in mid-game added a nice jolt of unpredictability, especially the one dressed as a groundskeeper who startled my sister into dropping her phone. That novelty wore off fast once we hit the middle puzzle, a jigsaw-style wall panel with three pieces missing entirely, which the staff later blamed on 'wear and tear' without offering to adjust our time. The story itself, something about a cursed vineyard, had potential. But the ending clue was written in cursive so faded it was borderline unreadable, and by the time we deciphered it, the buzzer had already sounded, cutting off what could've been a decent finish.
label: negative

text: The stained glass installation near the entrance threw beautiful colored light across the floor all morning, a nice surprise nobody mentioned online. That goodwill faded fast once I hit the medieval armor exhibit, where half the placards were only in a language I didn't understand, with no translation offered anywhere nearby. Restrooms were down a confusing maze of hallways with signage that pointed in contradictory directions, and I ended up asking three different staff members before finding one. To cap it off, a fire alarm test went off unannounced during the quiet meditation room's one peaceful hour, and nobody came to explain or apologize afterward.
label: negative

text: What sold me was the peer-reviewed assignments, getting feedback from strangers pushed me to actually try harder. The instructor answered my email question within a day, which felt unusually responsive for an online class. Layout of the dashboard took some getting used to at first.
label: positive

text: At Riddle Room Chicago, the 'Haunted Manor' experience started twenty minutes late because the front desk person, a guy named Marcus, couldn't find our booking in the system. Once inside, the fog machine set off the smoke detector and we had to evacuate for ten minutes. By the time we got back in, half the group had lost interest entirely.
label: negative

text: Getting a same-week slot took some doing since they only had a Tuesday morning open, which meant rearranging my whole schedule. Worth mentioning because when I picked up my poodle, the topknot was shaped so precisely it looked like it had been drawn with a compass, and they'd hand-stripped the wiry patches on her legs instead of just shaving them down like most places do. Fifty-five dollars for a cut this exact felt like getting away with something.
label: positive

text: Communication about arrival time was a little shaky and I texted twice for updates, but then I watched them carry my washing machine up a narrow apartment staircase like it weighed nothing.
label: positive

text: Three months in and the hinge already creaks like a rusty gate every time I open the lid.

text: The truck showed up a bit smaller than what I'd asked for, so there was some awkward repacking. Still, the two young guys treated my late dad's old workbench like it was made of glass, wrapping every corner before sliding it down the ramp. They even swept out my old apartment before locking up.

text: The waiting area is cramped, just two folding chairs and a rack of half-finished garments crowding the doorway. I'll admit I stood for most of my forty-minute wait. Still, when he pinned the waist of my mother's dress for the alteration, he caught a asymmetry in the original stitching that three other tailors had missed entirely. The zipper he replaced afterward glided without a single catch, and the seams inside were finished so cleanly they looked like they belonged in a museum piece rather than a forty-year-old gown pulled from a closet.
label: positive

text: dropped off my shih tzu at 9am and didnt get her back till almost 5pm, no call no update nothing. when i finally picked her up she was shaved down to the skin even tho i asked for just a trim around the paws. poor thing was shivering in the car ride home. wont be going back

text: My kid was terrified going in and the staff did nothing to make her comfortable, just kind of talked over her the whole time. The dentist was rough with the tools and she cried afterward saying her jaw hurt. We're finding a new pediatric dentist immediately.

text: Three months with the Honeywell T9 and the multi-room sensors have solved our basement being ten degrees colder than the living room. Installation was straightforward using their video guide, took my dad and me about 40 minutes total including drilling new holes. Energy reports emailed monthly show we're using 12% less than last year at this time. The app occasionally lags when switching between rooms, but that's my only real complaint after regular use.
label: positive

text: needed same day passport photos before a flight and they had me in and out in like 15 min, background lighting was perfect and no weird shadows. staff cracked jokes the whole time which made the wait actually fun
label: positive

text: Checked in late and the office was already closed so we had to find our spot in the dark with headlamps, a little stressful honestly. But the site backed right up to a ravine with its own little waterfall, and falling asleep to that sound instead of some generator was the best trade I could've asked for.
label: positive

text: Skis from the place next to the gondola came with edges so dull I couldn't hold an edge on groomed blue runs. Told the woman at the counter, Denise I think, and she just shrugged and said 'that's how they come in February.' Spent $58 for gear that made intermediate terrain feel like ice.
label: negative

text: gotta say the recipe search filters are genuinely useful, i can sort by ingredients i have on hand which saved me a grocery trip once. the photos are also high quality, not the blurry stock stuff you get elsewhere. unfortunately every single time i try to save a recipe to my favorites the app crashes, without exception, i've tested this like ten times now on two different phones. lost track of a pasta recipe i wanted to make for a dinner party and had to scramble to find it again through my browser history. the ads between steps while cooking are also obnoxious, popping up right when your hands are covered in flour. nice pictures don't help much if you can't actually keep any of the recipes.
label: negative

text: A friend's recommendation led me to a slow-burn mystery series that hooked me within an episode, exactly the kind of thing the platform claims to be good at surfacing. But typing a specific title into the search bar now returns unrelated results half the time — searching for a director's name pulled up three cooking shows and a nature documentary before anything relevant appeared. The recommendation row has repeated the same eight titles for going on six weeks, regardless of what I actually finish watching, including a rom-com I explicitly marked 'not interested' in twice. Browsing by genre isn't much better, since the horror category still lists a children's animated film about a friendly ghost.
label: negative
